source.title: Finetuning LLMs for Human Behavior Prediction in Social Science Experiments

claim: Fine-tuning improved some held-out response-distribution metrics; individual prediction and distribution fit are distinct targets.

outcome.name: Held-out response accuracy and response-distribution distance
outcome.window: Offline held-out studies and conditions; not a prospective field deployment

limitations: Public corpus access is not blanket commercial or redistribution clearance.
Survey-response prediction is not evidence of intervention benefit.
Study-wise separation is required; model and prompt leakage require audits.
